d: In this episode the brothers shun the more famous areas, Tokyo and Kyoto, and head to the isolated, ancient island of Shikoku. Their route is the ancient 88 Temple Zen pilgrimage circuit.

By pick-up truck, the brothers route is the culturally and geographically rich island of Cape Breton and the Cabot Trail. Lobster fishing, hooking, moose sightings, Bingo, Scottish ceilidhs, Mi'kmaq drum session, it's all happening in this episode.
Local exploring in industrial Charleroi, brings Cody to abandoned factories and an unknown spot full of colorful graffiti. An old casino awaits to be explored.
In this episode, Piri is in Wellington with his dive team, the ‘Kina Crew'. The boys hit the west and southern coastlines to collect kai moana ahead of their annual ‘AGM'.
In this episode, Piri is in the Chatham Islands hunting wild ram and weka with one of the locals known as Big Jase.
In this episode, Piri is in the Chatham Islands meeting up with local, Floyd Prendeville, who takes Piri spear fishing for Hapuka and drifting for flounder.

Xander and his team drive eleven hours to Dullstroom, a quaint town where fishing and drinking prevails. Across the pond, Adam's desire to participate with Xander and his crew takes him all the way to the grocery store.
On opposite sides of the world, Adam and a member of the South African crew each attempt to conquer their fears.
As Xander and his crew travel into the bush, they discover South Africa's most beautiful qualities: national parks, safaris, and magnificent wildlife.

Tayler and Jason take on their final peak in Washington State, Mt Baker. Tayler struggles when Jason explains all the things that could go wrong, but the reality is a lot could fail if they don't come together as a team.
Fleeing the hard monsoon rains, Jonathan seeks refuge with hot cups of java in the rolling hills of India's coffee country and in the peaceful energy of India's largest Tibetan community.
